name: coda
description: Connect Coda to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Coda MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Coda to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with docs, pages and tables using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Coda workspace.
Find anything in Coda that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review docs, pages and tables in Coda.
